description:
Full item detail bundle. Everything the item page shows, in one response: `item` (name, description, category, icon, stack size,
despawn seconds, craftable flag), `recipe` (components with quantities), `blueprint_costs` (unlock source,
scrap cost, workbench tier), `recycle` (yields per recycler type with chance), `repair`, `loot_sources`
(every crate/NPC/barrel that drops it, with `chance_pct` and `amount`, highest chance first), `used_in`
(items this one is an ingredient of), `skins` (the first 24 skins by price, each with `price` and
`store_price` in USD cents, `subscriptions` and `released`), `skins_total` and `similar` (six items from the
same category). Page through all skins with `/items/{shortname}/skins`. Cached for 15 minutes.
name: get_item
title: Full item detail bundle
